items.title: Scaling enterprise security standards across the Marketplace
items.summary: A note from our CISO Our largest enterprise customers run their most critical workflows on Atlassian cloud products. For many of them, that work relies heavily on apps built by our Marketplace partners to customize and extend Jira, Confluence, and the rest of our platform.
